claims.note: Clarke 2024 (Nature, online 2024-08-14), title 'A Scottish provenance for the Altar Stone of Stonehenge'; abstract: detrital age comparisons 'reveal a remarkable similarity to the Old Red Sandstone of the Orcadian Basin in northeast Scotland'.
